scientific_integrity: The elementary-collapse and finite incidence claims are recomputed exhaustively by the embedded standalone verifier; the homotopy deduction uses a simply connected 2-complex and the homological Whitehead theorem.
scientific_limitations: Only the graph-geodesic general-position simplicial complex of the 12-vertex icosahedral graph is classified. No equivariant homotopy, extension to other graphs, or external independent audit is claimed.
title: The icosahedral geodesic general-position complex is \(\bigvee^{6}S^{1}\vee\bigvee^{21}S^{2}\)
